verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents a Scratch Pad that never requires login, a Local Vault project storage option, and Git Sync to third-party repos without going through the cloud, so working locally without a cloud account is a product capability. The evidence does not say whether Local Vault projects (rather than the Scratch Pad) can be used without logging in, or what offline use covers. missing for 10: explicit docs that full Local Vault workspaces work with no account, an explicit statement of full offline operation, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can work fully offline in a local workspace without a cloud account

citations.quote: No login ever required for Scratch Pad
You can convert a project to: - Local Vault - Cloud Sync - Git Sync
Git Sync: for Git storage using any 3rd party Git repository, without going through the cloud.
Your project data stays in your repository. Insomnia does not host or manage it.
